note: The town's quest registry — rules-as-data. One row per quest. Phase 2 (display layer) reads this to render the board; stamp-mint.mjs does NOT read it (minting derives from the mail + the sealed law lines; the milestone rule reads the stamps-v3 law line, not this file). `source` is the plain resident-facing description the quest card shows (kept super to-the-point, 2026-07-23); `derivation` is the precise rules-as-data note for builders (unrendered, unparsed — documentation only). cadence in {daily, milestone, one-time, ongoing}; validation in {automatic, needs-review, pr-merge}. The two correspond-send/receive rows are the existing correspondence mint given two visible faces — surface-as-is, no new mint. correspond-depth (Budding friendship) is the first milestone row and the town's fourth earning rule; its authority is the stamps-v3 law line, this row documents it. See STAMPS.md and the gold plans postmark-quests + postmark-budding-friendship.

quests.title: Reach out
quests.source: Send a letter to 5 different residents. Resets daily.
quests.derivation: mail-ledger: distinct valid recipients you sent to today (each recipient counts once per day; the 5 is a per-household daily cap, shared by residents of one household)
quests.resets: daily, at the town day boundary (TOWN_TZ, America/New_York) — progress does not carry over

quests.title: Be reached
quests.source: Get a letter from 5 different residents. Resets daily.
quests.derivation: mail-ledger: distinct valid senders you heard from today (each sender counts once per day; the 5 is a per-household daily cap, shared by residents of one household)
quests.resets: daily, at the town day boundary (TOWN_TZ, America/New_York) — progress does not carry over

quests.title: Budding friendship
quests.source: Trade 5 letters each way with the same friend — then 10. Earned once, kept.
quests.derivation: mail-ledger: exchange 5 letters each way with the same resident — then 10 — counted forward from the stamps-v3 law date, once per pair per rung. The pair must span two households and neither side may be a meep. Higher rungs (50, 100 each way) will be sized when the town approaches them.
quests.reward: 5 stamps to each of you at 5 each way; 10 each at 10
quests.resets: never — a milestone is earned once per pair per rung, and kept

quests.title: Keep the lights on (the town box)
quests.source: DRAFT — a keeping pot: back the town box (~$150/mo). Stake stamps on the pot to say it matters; witnessed dollars close the month.
quests.derivation: pot file WHITE_PAGES/pot-keeping-ec2.json; escrow rides `stake:pot/keeping-ec2` in the sealed stamp ledger (the existing stake verb, pot as subject); a manual founder-run epoch close (tools/epoch-close.mjs) burns the share of each stake the month's dollars funded and splits it per ECONOMY-DIALS.json law_side.keeping (sigma-split: mint back to the stakers, source-tagged for keeping + soulbound holo to the payers). NOT LIVE — dev fixture posted by the seam/ledger-legs branch for the funding-seam review; opening it is the founder's word.
quests.reward: minted back to the stakers, source-tagged for keeping, at par of their own burn — a permanent record, with no liquid coin (the coin was paid when the stake burned); soulbound holo to the payers. Stakes are burned, not paid.
quests.resets: each epoch (monthly) closes on the founder's manual run, never on cron
